prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for all kinds of change (adoption/new_screen, choose_path/copy, finish/redesign, home/wait_info) as each only has 1 test.
Predictions were consistently too high across all tests compared to measured and noise-corrected results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: -1.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, copy: -0.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: -3.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +0.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Defer Sign-In After Pet Selection: Move the sign_in step to occur after adoption choices so users build attachment to their companion before authenticating. (why: Sign in currently experiences a 27.1% dropoff early in the funnel; letting users choose their pet first increases investment before requiring account sign-in.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Visibility Diagnostic Screen: Add a dedicated verification screen before home completion that guides users to confirm desktop overlay permissions and pet visibility. (why: 3 support tickets reported pet not showing on desktop or app failing to open, while waiting step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Photo Upload Guidelines Flow: Insert a photo guidelines preparation step before photo upload to ensure users submit high-quality images for custom pets. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet creation failing or producing bad visual results, driving adoption conversion down to 60.9%.)
3: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Time Estimate and Progress Tips: Display live time estimates and rotating tips on the waiting screen while background desktop pet assets build. (why: The waiting step has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading users to abandon setup while pet rendering occurs.)
4: [sign_in, copy] Account Desktop Pet Sync Clarification Copy: Update sign-in screen headline and hint to explicitly mention that signing in preserves your pet across app re-installs and logins. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or being reset after signing in again, causing account-related friction.)
5: [finish, hint] Desktop Controls Quick Reference Guide: Add quick key binding hints and control summary badges to the home intro screen. (why: 3 support tickets noted confusion after onboarding about how to control, hide, or interact with the pet once active.)
6: [home, notification] Background Pet Readiness Desktop Notification: Enable desktop notification alert toggle on the waiting screen so users are notified when pet setup finishes. (why: Home wait time mean is 2336s, showing that users minimize the application during asset generation and forget to return.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Compact Layout for Path Selection: Switch choose_path layout to compact presentation with step progress indicator for faster decision making. (why: choose_path mean time is 514s despite 8s median, indicating a long tail of users stuck reviewing options.)

scores.note: Addresses major sign_in dropoff by deferring friction until after user investment, though requires flow refactoring.
Adding a new screen to onboarding historically degraded conversion (-1.8%), despite support tickets.
Adoption has high dropoff and 3 support tickets, but adding pre-steps adds onboarding friction.
Matches previous positive test (home wait_info +0.6%) and addresses severe wait time dropoff.
Strong evidence with 8 support emails and sign_in dropoff; low-cost copy change.
Addresses post-onboarding confusion via lightweight hints, though target step impact is modest.
Directly targets long wait time (2336s mean) by letting users leave and return when ready.
Addresses long tail dwell time on choose_path, though baseline conversion is already high.
